dataset.name: met.no ROMS Norkyst800m ZDepths hourly files

metadata.documentation: MET Norway's operational ocean model ROMS is run on the NorKyst-800m grid, a polar-stereographic grid covering the Norwegian coastal zone with 800 m grid spacing. The model is run daily (00UTC) with atmospheric forcing from Arome2.5km, vertical boundary conditions from Nordic-4km, and tides from TPXO 7.2, to provide forecasts to +66 hrs.
